mechanism: Portland cement shipments track construction and infrastructure activity; firm shipment growth marks an upswing in real investment, slowing shipments a construction slowdown.
key_finding: On today's revised cement values with point-in-time release dates (no archive of first releases), the rule selected on in-sample data uses chg_6m / T0_zero at L8 (IS Sharpe 1.47); test-period Sharpe 0.63 versus buy-and-hold SPY 0.93. Smallest cement-to-SPY Granger p-value 0.14 (lag 2; 1.00 after the 12-lag Bonferroni adjustment).
caveats: USGS revises earlier months and no archive of first-published values exists: the backtest uses today's values (revision lookahead unquantified).
The strategy is search-selected and needs fresh holdout validation.
The training period is short (the cement series starts 2005-11; rolling windows need several years).
Data Master's cement series ends 2025-06, so later months are not tested.
narrative_summary: Portland cement shipment growth is tested as a construction-activity filter for SPY.
